boundary.policy: Gleam owns Telegram schemas, identity checks, pure state transitions, canonical authority/fences, retries and dispatch. Native worker is a bounded isolated SQLite storage facade only.
boundary.worker: Prebuilt pinned OCaml executable under native/ocaml or Hermes owned module, launched per bounded request under existing process-group guardian from OTP. No shell, compilation, network, service-control policy, arbitrary SQL or arbitrary executable choice exposed to Telegram.
boundary.transport: Add narrowly typed storage facade over guardian framed input. Finite request/response JSON schemas, binary32 length, explicit byte/output/deadline bounds. Native errors are finite redacted codes. Existing MAX limits/behavior unchanged.

data_model.kind: Atomic bounded key/value rows plus append-only operation receipts; schema and SQL fixed in native facade. Gleam codec validates every loaded domain value and immutable identity.
data_model.row: key, version, canonical_value_bytes, sha256. Version and hash compare-and-swap for every changed row; create requires absent. No delete operation.

read bounded explicit keys or bounded inbox index; explicit missing rows

atomic apply fixed list of expected-version/hash changes with stable operation_id and whole request digest; replay same op/same digest returns durable original receipt; same op/different digest refuses
atomicity: inbox raw input/record and watermark commit in one transaction, only after whole accepted prefix model validation
result record and every chunk commit together before any network send

no network, risk subprocess, task CLI or model IO inside transaction

bounds.semantics: Reject before mutation when a bound is exceeded. FULL durable history is retained; initial implementation has no pruning or deleting API. Bound stops are visible and never advance offset.

durability: Dedicated local private state directory owned by service user0700; DB/WAL/SHM0600, no state in repository source tracking.
PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL, synchronous=FULL, foreign_keys=ON and bounded busy_timeout; query effective values and refuse mismatches.
Initialize exact schema with transactional metadata; no implicit migration of unknown schema. Transactions use BEGIN IMMEDIATE and fixed parameterized statements.

Explicit operation receipt and state changes in same transaction. COMMIT success is only acknowledged after real commit return. Crash/timeout before response means unknown until exact op receipt is reread.
No generic checkpoint, VACUUM, delete, repair or external tree operation in production facade.
Assume trusted same Unix-account writers and truthful filesystem flushes; no claim of resilience against malicious same-UID replacement or broken hardware.
authority: Storage facade grants no Telegram or task effect authority; Gleam checks current service singleton/runtime/task fences and budget before every transition.
Domain state contains actual request plan/task/attempt, coordinator epochs, owner and result digest; never reconstruct defaults.
Outbox generation/version checks prevent concurrent send claim; once SENDING is durable, any crash recovery becomes UNCERTAIN and no automatic resend.
Service process lifetime singleton and stable operation IDs are required; competing updates with stale versions refuse.
tests: Real isolated file DB pragma readbacks, process restart and exact row/hash recovery.
